contexts.text: Sometimes the delight (of adulterers) is turned into the stink of human ordure... This stench takes possession of Hell by turns, and by turns ceases; it is their delight from adulteries which is turned into such a stench. SE 2624.
Under Dung, see these references. AC 3941:5. AC 10037. SE 2660.
They who do not receive, are separated from those who are within the Divine Man, as the feces and urine are separated from man.
Barley mixed with dung = truths falsified and profaned.

On account of the correspondence of filthy loves with dung and mire, it was commanded the Sons of Israel, that they should carry with them a paddle with which to cover their excrement, lest Jehovah God walking in the midst of their camp should see the nakedness of the thing, and should turn back ().

The love of self is merely a corporeal love, springing from the boiling up and fermentation of the obsolete parts... That the love of self is from this origin, may appear from its correspondence with human ordure; for they who have been addicted to this love, in the other life love stercoraceous filth above everything, the stench thereof being grateful to them...
A cake of barley made with dung = this adulteration (of the Divine truth or of the Word with the Jewish nation)... Dung = infernal evil.
The clay, mire, and dung of the streets = the falsity of the love of evil. Illustrated.
They shall be for dung upon the faces of the earth () = what is filthily infernal, which is evil defiling the good and truth of the Church.
They shall be for dung upon the faces of the earth () = what is merely false and evil, without any reception of life from Heaven.
They shall be for dung upon the faces of the earth () = such a deadness and uncleanness that it is cast out and trampled upon.
